guide.mod_70022c7a.guide.firework.detail: Gravity multiplier = max(5%, 100% - 50% x power); 2 pieces leave ~25% gravity, 3+ are nearly flat. Trail density scales with power.
guide.mod_70022c7a.guide.slime_block.det: Bounces = min(2, floor(power)); retained speed = 60% + 20% x power.
guide.mod_70022c7a.guide.echo.detail: Returns always at power >= 70%, otherwise with a chance equal to power. Ignores collision while returning.
guide.mod_70022c7a.guide.pearl.detail: Teleports the shooter to a safe spot near the impact and resets fall distance.
guide.mod_70022c7a.guide.chorus.detail: Teleport radius = 8 x power blocks, dropping the target on nearby open ground; bosses are immune.
guide.mod_70022c7a.guide.slime.detail: Pull strength = 0.7 x power, dragging the target toward the shooter.
guide.mod_70022c7a.guide.bell.detail: Hostile mobs within 8 blocks are lured toward the impact for 100 x power ticks (~5 x power seconds).
guide.mod_70022c7a.guide.horn.detail: Radius = 4 + 2 x power blocks, push = 0.4 x power; knockback only, no damage.
guide.mod_70022c7a.guide.honey.detail: The arrow pins the target, dealing 0.5 x power physical damage every 20 ticks (1 second).
guide.mod_70022c7a.guide.blaze.detail: Ignite radius = 1 + round(1.5 x power) blocks; about half of flammable blocks catch fire for 4 x power seconds.
guide.mod_70022c7a.guide.web.detail: Places round(2 x power) cobwebs on nearby air blocks only.
guide.mod_70022c7a.guide.bone.detail: Growth radius = 1 + floor(power) blocks; each crop grows by 1 + power stages.
guide.mod_70022c7a.guide.snow.detail: Extinguish radius = 1 + floor(power) blocks; puts out all fire blocks in range.
guide.mod_70022c7a.guide.glowstone.detai: Places a light block (level 15) on the surface at the impact.
guide.mod_70022c7a.guide.gunpowder.detai: Shock radius = 2 + round(2 x power) blocks, push = 0.5 x power; no damage, no block damage.
guide.mod_70022c7a.guide.dragon.detail: Damage radius = 1.5 + 0.8 x power blocks; entities inside take 2 x power damage (not a potion effect).
guide.mod_70022c7a.guide.prismarine.deta: Deals 1.0 x power magic damage to the target, ignoring armor and resistance.
guide.mod_70022c7a.guide.amethyst.detail: All entities within 3 blocks take 0.6 x power magic damage (shooter excluded).
guide.mod_70022c7a.guide.bow_firework.de: Bow mod: each piece adds +18% arrow speed; stacks with other mods.
guide.mod_70022c7a.guide.bow_blaze.detai: Bow mod: fired arrows burn for 160 seconds and ignite targets.
guide.mod_70022c7a.guide.bow_glowstone.d: Bow mod: reduces arrow spread (equivalent to +2 Stability).
guide.mod_70022c7a.guide.bow_blaze.name: Blaze Powder
hint.mod_70022c7a.slot.0: Feather slot: 1 feather per arrow; craft as many as materials allow.
hint.mod_70022c7a.slot.1: Stick slot: 1 stick per arrow; 1 plank covers 8 arrows.
hint.mod_70022c7a.slot.2: Arrowhead slot: each head material supplies a fixed number of arrows (see the guide), consumed per arrow with banking; leave empty for no arrowhead (no bonus damage). 1 potion = 8 potion arrows (no arrow damage, applies the potion effect).
hint.mod_70022c7a.slot.3: Effect slot 1 (Copper tier): one of 18 items (firework, slime block, echo shard, ender pearl, chorus fruit, slime ball, bell, goat horn, honey bottle, blaze powder, cobweb, bone meal, snowball, glowstone, gunpowder, dragon breath, prismarine shard, amethyst block). 1 piece per 4 arrows; same-type stacks diminish.
hint.mod_70022c7a.slot.4: Effect slot 2 (Iron tier): one more item effect. 1 piece per 4 arrows; same-type stacks diminish.
hint.mod_70022c7a.slot.5: Effect slot 3 (Gold tier): one more item effect. 1 piece per 4 arrows; same-type stacks diminish.
hint.mod_70022c7a.slot.6: Effect slot 4 (Diamond tier): one more item effect. 1 piece per 4 arrows; same-type stacks diminish.
hint.mod_70022c7a.slot.7: Effect slot 5 (Netherite tier): one more effect. 1 material per 4 arrows; potions 1 per 8.
hint.mod_70022c7a.slot.8: Output slot: shows how many arrows current materials can make; take it to craft and consume them. Up to a full stack (64) per craft.
hint.mod_70022c7a.slot.9: Arrow slot: put modified arrows here to enchant (Gold tier).
hint.mod_70022c7a.slot.10: Lapis slot: each enchant consumes 1-3 lapis lazuli (Gold tier).
hint.mod_70022c7a.slot.11: Output slot: enchanted arrows appear here (Gold tier).
hint.mod_70022c7a.slot.12: Bow slot: put a bow here for modification (Netherite tier).
hint.mod_70022c7a.slot.13: Bow material slot: firework rocket (strong boost), blaze powder (flame) or glowstone dust (focus).
hint.mod_70022c7a.slot.14: Bow material slot: firework rocket (strong boost), blaze powder (flame) or glowstone dust (focus).
hint.mod_70022c7a.slot.15: Bow material slot: firework rocket (strong boost), blaze powder (flame) or glowstone dust (focus).
hint.mod_70022c7a.slot.16: Bow material slot: firework rocket (strong boost), blaze powder (flame) or glowstone dust (focus).
hint.mod_70022c7a.slot.17: Bow material slot: firework rocket (strong boost), blaze powder (flame) or glowstone dust (focus).
hint.mod_70022c7a.slot.18: Upgrade slot: insert the next metal block (copper, iron, gold, diamond, netherite block) to upgrade instantly, consuming 1. The ghost icon shows the required block.
